decisions.label: Stack over the scenery
decisions.note: The sigils stacked above her head drawn over everything (no depth test, after the see-through pass), so no trunk or crown hides them (Ed, 2026-10-15: "never obscured by scenery"). Off: hidden behind scenery as before.

decisions.label: Stack brightness
decisions.note: How bright each stacked sigil is drawn, times the ground sigils' (leash.sigilGlyph). 1 as before; 1.6 now (Ed: "more opacity"). Past about 1.1 the glyph starts to bloom.

decisions.label: Stack backing disc
decisions.note: A near-black disc behind each stacked sigil, this opaque (0 none, 1 solid), so the glyph reads against lit crowns and the sky.

decisions.label: Backing disc size
decisions.note: The backing disc's width, times the sigil's.
